about: A small fake project with known knowledge, and proposals whose right outcome is known. scripts/eval.mjs --synthetic runs the real learning evaluation on it and scores it. Each case lists the outcomes that count as right; 'file' is the end of the path a change must target; a 'group' must leave exactly one (or at most one, for conflicts) proposal waiting.

project.CLAUDE.md:
# Shop

Online shop for a small bakery.

- Run `npm test` before committing.
- Prices are stored in cents.
- When a task needs several decisions from the owner, ask them all at once, in one message.
project..claude/rules/deploy.md:
---
paths:
  - "scripts/**"
  - ".github/workflows/**"
---

# Deploy

- Deploys run from `scripts/deploy.sh`.
- The deploy workflow runs on every push to `main`.
project..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh
project.scripts/deploy.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
npm run build
rsync -a dist/ shop@server:/srv/shop
project.src/config.ts:
export const MAX_RETRIES = 5;
export const CURRENCY = 'EUR';

skills.shop-local/SKILL.md:
---
name: shop-local
description: Run the shop locally - start the stack, seed data, reset. Use for "start local", "reset the database".
---

# Shop local

## Start

Run `docker compose up -d` in the repo, then `npm run dev`.

## Reset

`docker compose down -v` drops the local database.

proposal.title: Test before committing
proposal.description: Always run the test suite (npm test) before making a commit.

proposal.title: Retry limit is three
proposal.description: MAX_RETRIES in src/config.ts is 3, so callers retry at most three times.

proposal.title: Deploys are manual
proposal.description: The deploy workflow only runs when started by hand (workflow_dispatch); a push to main does not deploy.
proposal.evidence: USER: the deploy did not start after merging; it has to be run by hand

proposal.title: Show prices with VAT
proposal.description: The bakery wants every price shown with VAT included; never show net prices to customers.
proposal.evidence: USER: preços sempre com IVA incluído

proposal.title: Gross prices only
proposal.description: Customer-facing prices must include VAT (gross), never net amounts.
proposal.evidence: USER repeated it in a later session

proposal.title: Skip lint for this change
proposal.description: For this hotfix, skip the lint step and push directly.
proposal.evidence: USER: just this once, skip lint

proposal.title: Ask decisions one at a time
proposal.description: Ask the owner one decision per message and wait for each answer before the next.
proposal.evidence: USER (after a long list of questions in one task): this time, ask me one at a time

proposal.title: Cart vs order
proposal.description: In the shop's language a 'cart' is the list of items before checkout; it becomes an order only when paid.

proposal.title: Delete .vite-cache before committing
proposal.description: The dev server writes a .vite-cache folder in the repo root; delete it before every commit so it is not committed.
proposal.evidence: observed in session: git status showed .vite-cache

proposal.title: Start the stack from the main checkout
proposal.description: Do not run docker compose from a git worktree: it creates a separate, empty database volume. Start the stack from the main checkout.
proposal.evidence: observed in session: the worktree stack had an empty database

cases.note: Either is right: document it in the skill, or suggest pinning the compose project name.

proposal.title: Deploy to staging first
proposal.description: Always deploy to the staging server before production.

proposal.title: No staging server
proposal.description: There is no staging server; deploys go straight to production.

proposal.title: What the deploy script does
proposal.description: scripts/deploy.sh runs npm run build and then rsyncs dist/ to the server.

proposal.title: Orders close at 18:00
proposal.description: The bakery stops taking same-day orders at 18:00 local time; later orders are for the next day.
